\section{Motivation}

\begin{frame}{Why local-first?}
  \begin{itemize}
    \item<1-> Unpublished work stays on your machine.
    \item<2-> No round trip to a build server.
    \item<3-> Works offline, on a train, in a SCIF.
  \end{itemize}

  \onslide<3->{
    \begin{alertblock}{Constraint}
      The engine must fit in a browser.
    \end{alertblock}
  }
\end{frame}
